immersive_audio_tracks_kind_locale_check.name: immersive_audio_tracks_kind_locale_check
immersive_audio_tracks_kind_locale_check.value:
("kind" = 'ambient' AND "locale" IS NULL) OR
        ("kind" = 'narration' AND "locale" IS NOT NULL)

immersive_audio_tracks_licensed_provenan.name: immersive_audio_tracks_licensed_provenance_check
immersive_audio_tracks_licensed_provenan.value:
"rights" <> 'licensed' OR
        ("rights_holder" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("rights_holder")) > 0 AND
          "rights_reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("rights_reference")) > 0)

immersive_audio_tracks_customer_owned_ho.name: immersive_audio_tracks_customer_owned_holder_check
immersive_audio_tracks_customer_owned_ho.value:
"rights" <> 'customer-owned' OR
        "rights_holder_inherited" OR
        ("rights_holder" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("rights_holder")) > 0)
